content:
The Supreme Court questioned the growing use of pregnancy termination in marital disputes, raising concerns about the father’s rights when a wife seeks termination due to conflicts with her husband and in-laws. A Bench comprising Justice B.V. Nagarathna and Justice R. Mahadevan highlighted the complex balance between reproductive autonomy, marital discord and the legal rights of both parents.

Case Analysis 👉🏻 🔗 https://lnkd.in/df9Be42w
comment: The difficult question is how courts distinguish genuine marital coercion from disputes over reproductive decisions. Any framework must protect bodily autonomy without turning parenthood into a source of legal leverage.
